name: Fantasy wizard tower
summary: A charming stone-base, jettied timber-frame tower with ivy, lanterns and a balcony telescope, but the cone reads as a flat lid with a spike stuck on top, so it never reaches the tall crooked wizard-hat silhouette the brief asks for.

log.summary: A charming stone-base, jettied timber-frame wizard tower with ivy, lanterns, a balcony and a telescope, but the tall cone is really a flat verdigris lid with a thin crooked spire stuck on top, so it doesn't read as a conical wizard hat from the front.
